column1: # Partition table for Pocket Notes on the Cardputer / Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3FN8
# The model (6.2 MB) and vocabulary are embedded in the app image (.incbin)
# holds code + model. The `storage` partition is LittleFS for notes kept in device memory (the
# app works without an SD card); 512 KB holds thousands of short notes.
# bmorcelli/Launcher writes the firmware to 0x10000 and replaces the running partition table on
# install; whether it honours the extra `storage` partition is not tested yet.
